title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 4.63 (versions follow prime numbers; 463 after 461): Luma ate Juvenilia, by Miguel Cané (1884), the memories of a student at the Colegio Nacional de Buenos Aires (public domain, from es.wikisource.org); it travels with the project in razar/comida-libre. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v4.63: Juvenilia, comida sana. Prototipo de investigación.
